definitions.explanation: For time to go by or pass.

examples.japanese: {時間|じかん}が{経|た}つのは{早|はや}い。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}してから{何十年|なんじゅうねん}も{経|た}った。
examples.english: Decades have passed since I moved.

notes:
{経|た}つ means for time to pass or elapse.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
- Pattern: {時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ (time passes)

DISTINCTION FROM {立|た}つ:
- {経|た}つ: time passing
- {立|た}つ: to stand; to rise

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～が{経|た}つ: time passes
- ～{経|た}ってから: after ~ passes
- {時間|じかん}が{経|た}つにつれて: as time passes
- {何年|なんねん}も{経|た}っている: many years have passed

ASPECT (ている/た):
- {経|た}っている: time has passed (current state)
- {経|た}った: passed (completed)

RELATED:
- {過|す}ぎる: to pass (time, place)
- {流|なが}れる: to flow (time metaphorically)
- {経|へ}る: to pass through, elapse (literary)
